column7: 2026-11-05: Decision (user's): when a Range header has more ranges than the new rangeParser `limit` option, do NOT reject or truncate. Instead merge them into ONE range from the lowest start to the highest end (gaps get included). Reason: their CDN can cache single-range responses but not multipart ones, and video players tolerate a few extra bytes. This replaces the earlier options of returning -1/-2, throwing, or truncating. Not yet implemented: next session writes it in index.js (rangeParser), with tests and README docs. Open points, my suggestions only (not agreed with user): count raw comma segments vs valid ranges, treat unset limit as no limit, and whether to apply the limit before or after combine.

2026-11-05: Implemented rangeParser limit (index.js, tests, README). Over limit => merge into one range (user's decision). My own choices, not agreed with user: count valid parsed ranges (not raw comma segments), unset/non-number/<1 limit = no limit, limit applied AFTER combine. Revisit if user disagrees.
